pluginSkillMetroMonitoringPackDesc: Install bundled assets for engineering and infrastructure scenarios: metro protection-area and operational monitoring, periodic reports, review responses, bidding, document preparation, data analysis, report generation, QA review, survey calculations, and engineering tools.

pluginSkillDibaoMonitoringDesc: Built-in metro protection-area monitoring Skill with scheme, daily, weekly, monthly, warning, summary, and review-response templates.
pluginSkillDibaoMonitoringDetail: Supports third-party metro protection-area monitoring deliverables: source document lists, schemes, point setup, initial values, daily/weekly/monthly reports, crossing-frequency logic, warnings, and summaries.
pluginSkillOperationalMonitoringDesc: Bundled from your operational-monitoring source package, including scheme, report, warning, and archive templates.
pluginSkillOperationalMonitoringDetail: Supports long-term deformation monitoring for operating urban rail structures, including settlement, convergence, clearance sections, 3D scanning, track-area vertical displacement, warnings, and archive templates.
pluginSkillTenderMasterDesc: Analyze tender documents, mirror scoring criteria, draft traceable responses, run compliance checks, and deliver verified bid files.
pluginSkillTenderMasterDetail: {{productName}}'s bundled Tender Master Skill includes a nine-stage bid workflow, four procurement modes, technical and commercial response rules, engineering-monitoring guidance, Chinese DOCX formatting, and local QA scripts. It never invents qualifications, cases, parameters, people, or pricing, and blocks final delivery while placeholders, evidence gaps, or unresolved deviations remain.
pluginSkillDocumentIllustratorDesc: Read articles, reports, and presentation sources to create consistent cover and section illustrations.
pluginSkillDocumentIllustratorDetail: Adapted from the MIT-licensed op7418/Document-illustrator-skill. It uses the image provider configured in {{productName}} instead of reading third-party .env credentials, and records the illustration plan, real output files, and insertion points.

pluginSkillSocialCardDetail: The upstream project is AGPL-3.0 and explicitly requires a separate commercial agreement for embedding in AI products or Agent platforms. {{productName}} links to the project but does not redistribute it without written authorization.
pluginSkillLogoGeneratorDesc: Generate multiple SVG logo directions and brand showcase materials.
pluginSkillLogoGeneratorDetail: The upstream README mentions MIT, but the repository has no formal LICENSE file or complete copyright permission notice. {{productName}} links to the project until a redistribution license or written authorization is available.
pluginSkillWritingHumanizerDesc: General AI-writing cleanup Skill for detecting and fixing formulaic prose.
pluginSkillWritingHumanizerDetail: From blader/humanizer. Useful for editing English or general prose by removing common AI tells such as promotional tone, vague attribution, formulaic structure, passive voice, and filler phrases.
pluginSkillWritingHumanizerZhDesc: Chinese humanizer Skill for reducing AI tone in Chinese text.
pluginSkillWritingHumanizerZhDetail: From op7418/Humanizer-zh. Designed for Chinese editing and review, focusing on transition clutter, summary voice, template phrasing, AI vocabulary, and Chinese-specific artificial tone.
pluginSkillWritingStopSlopDesc: Cuts AI slop and vague prose patterns.
pluginSkillWritingStopSlopDetail: From hardikpandya/stop-slop. A strong prose cleanup Skill that cuts filler, breaks formulaic structures, uses active voice, increases specificity, and varies rhythm.
pluginSkillWritingTasteDesc: Anti-slop frontend taste Skill for avoiding templated visual output.
pluginSkillWritingTasteDetail: From Leonxlnx/taste-skill, using the taste-skill subdirectory. This is for frontend pages, landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns, helping avoid generic AI-generated visual and copy patterns.
pluginSkillWritingAiFlavorDesc: Chinese AI-flavor removal and article polishing prompt, packaged as a Skill.
pluginSkillWritingAiFlavorDetail: From hylarucoder/ai-flavor-remover. {{productName}} packages the upstream prompt as an installable Skill for making Chinese AI drafts more natural while preserving meaning, logic, and key facts.
pluginSkillWritingShuorenhuaDesc: Chinese “say it like a person” rewrite Skill.
pluginSkillWritingShuorenhuaDetail: From MrGeDiao/shuorenhua. Useful for Chinese or mixed-language rewriting and review, with scene-aware handling for chat, status, docs, and public-writing contexts.
pluginSkillWritingNuwaDesc: Distill people, themes, or expression styles into runnable Skills.
pluginSkillWritingNuwaDetail: From alchaincyf/nuwa-skill. Used to research and generate new thinking or expression Skills from a person, theme, or fuzzy need. {{productName}} includes a slim copy with core Skill files, references, and scripts, excluding large promo images.
pluginSkillWritingAgentDesc: Multi-stage Chinese long-form and WeChat article writing workflow.
pluginSkillWritingAgentDetail: From dongbeixiaohuo/writing-agent. {{productName}} bundles the core agents, skills, styles, workflows, and templates for topic selection, clarification, style confirmation, outlining, drafting, review, humanization, and pre-publish checks.
pluginSkillPptMasterDesc: A professional workflow for turning Markdown, reports, plans, and source material into presentations.
pluginSkillPptMasterDetail: A controlled slim snapshot of the official hugohe3/ppt-master v4.0.0 release (commit 6636fb1). {{productName}} keeps the core Skill, references, workflows, all 55 top-level scripts and their modules, confirmation UI, SVG editor and preview, design specifications, and lightweight templates. Large icon libraries, AI comparison images, user projects, exports, backups, and private PPT files are excluded. requirements.txt is a {{productName}}-audited optional dependency overlay without Pandoc; automatic upstream updates remain disabled so unaudited files cannot replace the snapshot.
pluginSkillWritingDetectionDesc: AI-writing signal review based on HC3 comparison material.
pluginSkillWritingDetectionDetail: From Hello-SimpleAI/chatgpt-comparison-detection. {{productName}} wraps it as a review Skill for identifying ChatGPT/AI writing signals and turning them into revision suggestions. It is not an absolute detector.
pluginSkillWritingDeAiDesc: Chinese de-AI writing, polishing, translation, and review Skill.
pluginSkillWritingDeAiDetail: From the de-AI-writing folder in OUBIGFA/De-AI-Prompt-Enhancer-Writer-Booster-SKILL. Useful for Chinese rewriting, polishing, translation, and AI-trace review with lightweight reference loading.

sddAssistantStructureSub: Split into R blocks with acceptance criteria
sddAssistantStructurePrompt: Restructure the current requirement draft into structured requirement blocks and edit requirement.md directly. Format: each requirement uses a level-3 heading "### R-n: title" (n increments from 1; do not append any curly-brace status token). Each block contains a short description and an acceptance checklist (lines starting with "- [ ] ", each criterion concrete and verifiable). Preserve my intent, do not invent requirements; keep unrelated background content outside the blocks.
